This analysis does not include specific profit numbers because the source material provides only the confirmed facts. No preview written before the earnings release was found. Therefore, this analysis cannot compare earlier forecasts. It only reviews the official post-release announcement. The year-over-year comparison base is not provided. No further inference is made. Next quarter, attention should be paid to Data Center revenue continuity, gross margin trends, and management guidance.
